name: Shutter Wraith
status: approved visual spike; gameplay integration not included
coordinate_system: GLB: meters, +Y up, +Z forward. Build coordinates: Blender +Z up, -Y forward.
hover_note: Neutral exported vertex bounds are Y=0..12m. The lowest trailing tip defines Y=0; the main body and all three sentries are suspended above it. Display stage is 0.45m below this datum.
design: Open, cut donor cowl; separate painted Warden shutter panels around a visible suspended cyan heart; reaper blades recast as limbs and a torn mantle; distinct bell, crescent, and hood sentries.
